topic: Tool events lost while orchd is down or slow
detail: pre-tool-use gives orchd 20 ms; when orchd is down, refuses or is slower, the event is lost (the tool call still runs). A file spool fallback was not added because a spool cannot carry the caller's process identity, so its events could not be attributed (INV-02). Decide whether SP-014 should record gaps (e.g. orchd counting hook connections it did not finish, or a per-session sequence number) or accept the loss while the guard is off. SP-041 fails closed while enforcing, so this matters only for logging.
note: Settled by the user on 2026-11-09 in the SP-014 session; see D-30.
